raw.comments: Edit only Tablet/PowerCopiedFailureMove.tex. Preserve the Lean statement, imports, and support DAG; do not add a helper. At the start of the proof, define or restate L_{i,j}=PowerCopiedLeft_r(h,x,i,j) and cite PowerCopiedLeft whenever its clauses are used. In the depth-zero case, derive the raw failures for the adjacent pairs at rows n and n+1 from BadMultiSequence and the PowerShiftIter successor equation. Use the PowerCopiedLeft depth-zero equations to identify L_{n,0} and L_{n+1,0} with the corresponding PowerIResponse terms. Apply PowerIResponseLegal to the first raw failure for the legal move from the raw left value to L_{n,0}; apply PowerIResponseLegal to the second raw failure for the legal move from the raw right value to L_{n+1,0}; then apply PowerIResponseFailure to the first raw failure and that second legal move to obtain failure of (L_{n,0},L_{n+1,0}). In the successor step, explicitly cite PowerCopiedLeft for both successor equations L_{n,k+1}=PowerIResponse(L_{n,k},L_{n+1,k}) and L_{n+1,k+1}=PowerIResponse(L_{n+1,k},L_{n+2,k}); use the row-(n+1) legal-move induction fact as the right move in PowerIResponseFailure, and use the resulting failed pair plus the defining equation for L_{n,k+2} with PowerIResponseLegal to obtain the next left move. Keep the simultaneous induction over all rows and cite every cross-node dependency at its exact use.
